title: Resilient System Diagnostic
description: Build a complete diagnostic system that handles multiple error types, retries operations, and guarantees cleanup.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "The ship has 5 critical systems to check. Some may timeout, some may have corrupt data, some may be offline. Build a diagnostic that handles ALL error cases gracefully and continues checking remaining systems."
story.context: Production automation must be resilient. One failing component shouldn't crash the entire test suite. This challenge tests your ability to build robust error-handling workflows.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Incredible! You checked all 5 systems, handled 3 different error types, retried timeouts, used fallback values for corrupt data, and guaranteed cleanup. This is production-grade resilient automation!"

instructions: Create list of systems: @{systems} = Create List    Navigation    Power    Life Support    Communications    Engines
- IF ${system} == 'Power': Fail 'timeout: Power system not responding'
- IF ${error_count} > 2: Log 'WARNING: Multiple system issues detected'
hints: Nested structure: FOR loop contains TRY/EXCEPT/ELSE/FINALLY
Use glob pattern *timeout* to catch timeout errors
Three EXCEPT blocks: specific timeout, ValueError, general catch-all
FINALLY increments checked_count for EVERY system (success or fail)
ELSE only runs when TRY succeeds (no error)
IF conditions can use string comparison: '${system}' == 'Power'
Each system triggers different error or succeeds
All FOR and TRY blocks need END
solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Ship System Diagnostic
    @{systems}=    Create List    Navigation    Power    Life Support    Communications    Engines
    ${checked_count}=    Set Variable    0
    ${error_count}=    Set Variable    0
    FOR    ${system}    IN    @{systems}
        ${check_status}=    Set Variable    unknown
        TRY
            Log    Checking ${system}...
            IF    '${system}' == 'Power'
                Fail    timeout: Power system not responding
            END
            IF    '${system}' == 'Communications'
                Fail    ValueError: Invalid signal data
            END
            IF    '${system}' == 'Engines'
                Fail    CriticalError: Engine diagnostic offline
            END
            Log    ${system}: OK
            ${check_status}=    Set Variable    OK
        EXCEPT    *timeout*    AS    ${err}
            Log    ${system} timeout, retrying...
            Log    ${system} retry: OK (simulated)
            ${check_status}=    Set Variable    OK (retry)
            ${error_count}=    Set Variable    ${error_count + 1}
        EXCEPT    ValueError    AS    ${err}
            Log    ${system} data error: ${err}
            Log    Using fallback values for ${system}
            ${check_status}=    Set Variable    OK (fallback)
            ${error_count}=    Set Variable    ${error_count + 1}
        EXCEPT    AS    ${err}
            Log    ${system} CRITICAL: ${err}
            ${check_status}=    Set Variable    FAILED
            ${error_count}=    Set Variable    ${error_count + 1}
        ELSE
            Log    ${system} passed all checks
        FINALLY
            Log    ${system} final status: ${check_status}
            ${checked_count}=    Set Variable    ${checked_count + 1}
        END
    END
    Log    Diagnostic complete: ${checked_count}/5 systems checked
    Log    Errors handled: ${error_count}
    IF    ${error_count} > 2
        Log    WARNING: Multiple system issues detected
    END

theory.title: Challenge 3.2: Resilient System Diagnostic
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "This is the real test, PROTO-7. A diagnostic suite that handles every error gracefully. Multiple systems, multiple error types, retry logic, fallback values, guaranteed cleanup. This is what production automation looks like."

Complete Error Handling Architecture

Production-grade tests need:

  • Resilience: One failure doesn't stop everything
  • Error categorization: Different errors, different responses
  • Retry logic: Transient errors (timeouts) get retries
  • Fallback strategies: Bad data uses default values
  • Guaranteed cleanup: FINALLY ensures state is tracked
  • Comprehensive logging: Clear diagnostic output

⚠️ Challenge Architecture

  • FOR loop ensures all systems checked
  • TRY/EXCEPT inside loop prevents one error from stopping iteration
  • Multiple EXCEPT blocks handle different error types
  • Glob pattern *timeout* catches timeout-related errors
  • ELSE for success-specific logging
  • FINALLY for guaranteed status tracking (checked_count)
  • Post-loop summary provides diagnostic overview
  • This pattern scales to 100+ system checks

Expected Output Pattern

Checking Navigation...
Navigation: OK
Navigation passed all checks
Navigation final status: OK

Checking Power...
Power timeout, retrying...
Power retry: OK (simulated)
Power final status: OK (retry)

Checking Life Support...
Life Support: OK
Life Support passed all checks
Life Support final status: OK

Checking Communications...
Communications data error: ValueError: Invalid signal data
Using fallback values for Communications
Communications final status: OK (fallback)

Checking Engines...
Engines CRITICAL: CriticalError: Engine diagnostic offline
Engines final status: FAILED

Diagnostic complete: 5/5 systems checked
Errors handled: 3
WARNING: Multiple system issues detected
